answer: Make identity expensive through scarce attestation slots: each epoch only a thin orchard of established jurors may mint standing for newcomers. A farm that floods accounts still needs those jurors’ quill on the ledger, and every false stamp burns the juror’s own seat for weeks. Publish a public lantern of per-juror accuracy so dishonest panels lose future draws. Attacker cost scales with honest capacity, not with free account creation.
